name: manual_99d9e9
claim: Treat a history rewrite as cleanup, never as a safeguard. If an active credential was exposed, revoke or rotate it first. Rewrite on a throwaway mirror, scan every rewritten commit, and compare trees: equal to the old tip for a content-preserving rewrite, or to an approved sanitized baseline when the tip itself changes. Pin the push with force-with-lease to the expected SHA, let the operator run it, confirm with ls-remote, then request a host purge, because old SHAs stay reachable.
conditions: removing sensitive data from a repository
